reason: I already hunt the Tawfeer and supermarket offers myself, and paying cost plus $2 a bag only makes sense if you beat the deals I find. They don't promise any saving, and on $6,000 a year I count every dollar.
objection: I'd still have to go and collect it, at their hour, not mine. And the $2 is a sure cost while the savings are only a maybe.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing a few real receipts where the bag cost me clearly less than the same items at the offers I already follow, with a pickup point on my way home from Jounieh.
